name: Voyage AI (MongoDB)
description: Provides Voyage AI text, contextualized chunk, and multimodal embedding models plus rerankers through a MongoDB-hosted API, for developers building semantic search and RAG.

skills.name: Text Embeddings
skills.description: Converts text into vector embeddings for general-purpose and multilingual retrieval.

skills.name: Contextualized Chunk Embeddings
skills.description: Embeds document chunks with their surrounding context for more accurate retrieval.

skills.name: Multimodal Embeddings
skills.description: Vectorizes interleaved text and visual data such as PDF screenshots, slides, tables, figures, and videos.

skills.name: Reranking
skills.description: Scores relevance between a query and search results and reorders documents by that score.
